3-Model Triad Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High completed subsystem-by-subsystem Prototype-to-Scale Feasibility & DFM Audit for Photogenik Porcelain Scarab: (1) Subsystem TRL & N=1 Feasibility: Shrouded quad + outboard split elytra TRL 6-7 (80-85%), 0.18J spring launch TRL 5 (65-75%, simpler normal rotor takeoff first), 4-stage slotted cam + tendon TRL 4 (35-55%, tendon creep/tolerances -> use stamped SS/Nitinol flexures or 2nd 1.5g servo), 0W Perching TRL 5-6 (85% on magnetic steel wall discs or immaculate glass, <15% on dusty drywall -> make N52 magnetic target discs primary!), Micro-Fetch TRL 3-4 (30-45% teleop/beacon, <15% autonomous visual fetch), 10-Sensor Silicon PCB TRL 7-8 (90%+ to reflow on JLCPCB 6-layer rigid-flex, sample gases perched only), Autonomous Room-to-Room Nav + Re-Docking TRL 3-5 (65-75% final 30cm IR-beacon dock, 10-15% multi-room SLAM on ESP32S3 without off-board Nest compute); (2) Critical DFM Fixes for N=10,000 Scale: Replace coreless brushed motors (20-60h life = die before 1,000 flights) with 0802 brushless motors; replace knotted Dyneema tendon with molded POM cam / stamped flexure; FCC 15.521 UWB airborne transmission restriction -> put UWB anchor TX in the stationary Charging Nest or use BLE 6.0 Channel Sounding in flight; (3) Unit Economics: Full 10-sensor flagship BOM is ~100-150 USD at 5k units (449-599 USD retail), while a disciplined V1 Core SKU (camera + FIR + VOC + ToF/Flow + IR-beacon Nest + magnetic perch + elytra) hits 45-60 USD BOM for a 199-249 USD retail price (60-70% probability of working hero prototype in 12 months).

3-Model Triad Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High audited opening a cat wet-food can with the 41.65g Porcelain Scarab: (1) Direct Aerial Pull Fails by 33x-99x: Scarab net excess lift is (88 - 41.65) gf = 46.35 gf = 0.455 N, whereas an 85g aluminum ring-pull cat food can requires 15-25 N initial score-line rivet break and 30-45 N lid peel (~1.2-1.8 J work), and even a foil-seal tray requires 8-15 N; (2) Ranked Real-World Unlocks to Serve Wet Cat Food at 6:00 AM: #1 Triggering a Chilled Wet-Food Feeder or One-Touch Electric Opener via Pod C Capacitive Tarsi (<0.1 N touch pad) or IR/Sub-GHz; #2 Lifting a 2.5g Counterbalanced/Silicone Freshness Cloche off a Ice-Pack Chilled Bowl via Pod B Suction (0.025 N weight + <0.2 N non-stick rim seal < 0.455 N net thrust); #3 Tripping a Guarded Pre-Cocked Spring Can-Popper Dock (<0.3 N hair-trigger pin releases 2.5 J torsion spring while capturing the sharp lid safely away from paws).

3-Model Triad Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High completed Second-Pass Combinatorial Utility Unlocks for the Swiss-Army Porcelain Scarab (Sense -> Relocate -> Test -> Act -> Verify closed-loop state machine): (1) Bedside Sleep & Micro-Climate Shepherd (60GHz BGT60TR13C radar + FIR skin/duvet temp + STCC4/SCD41 CO2 -> flies to line-of-sight to fire supercap-buffered 940nm IR at AC/fan or CC1101 at paired shades + DOE 6-BPM ceiling breathing halo); (2) Kitchen & Soldering Bench Co-Pilot (BME688 VOC + FIR thermal hotspot -> Spotter beam marks unattended iron/mug + Capacitive Tarsi taps fume hood/timer + cold-surface-interlocked 9.2m/s air duster); (3) Multi-Sensory Home Detective (80kHz TDOA ultrasonic leak/whine -> FIR thermal anomaly -> 365nm UV-A residue check -> Spotter laser pinpoints exact spot); (4) Caretaking & Un-Ignoreable Waker (UWB/BLE 6.0 Hound + Stag Mandible / Suction courier + Capacitive Tarsi screen tap + 2.2m high-wall alarm perch); (5) Secret-Ink & Card-Dealing Tabletop Magic (Suction pod deals/fetches cards + 365nm UV-A reveals invisible ink clues + Mandible d6 fair dice drop + Spotter player selector); (6) 400mA Rail State-Machine & Supercap IR Buffer.

3-Model Triad Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High engineered the Swiss-Army Porcelain Scarab maximum utility architecture: 10+ permanent sub-gram silicon/photonic sensors weighing +1.4g to +2.5g bare silicon (+0.6g-0.8g flex/passives = +2.0g to +3.3g total) including eye-safe Class-1 laser/focused LED spotter, 365nm UV-A blacklight, DOE ceiling star/breathing halo projector, STHS34PF80/HTPA8x8/MLX90632 FIR thermal sensor, BME688 AI VOC nose, STCC4/SCD41 CO2 sensor, Infineon BGT60TR13C 60GHz mmWave contactless sleep breathing radar, Qorvo DW3110 UWB + nRF54L15 BLE 6.0 lost-item hound, 940nm IR blaster + CC1101 Sub-GHz universal wand, and 2x Knowles SPU0410LR5H 80kHz ultrasonic leak mics time-sliced via TI TPS22916/TPS22994 load switches to ~10-47mW perched draw, paired with swappable magnetic chin tool pods in the Nest (0.95g 3D stag mandibles, 0.80g 2D vacuum cup + peel tab, 0.25g capacitive touchscreen stylus tarsi, and 0.20g porous alumina scent wick + 9m/s prop-wash air duster).

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) physics & packaging bound on minimum feasible size for the Porcelain Scarab while retaining 100% of current indoor functionality (including 40mm 2.7g ping-pong ball fetch, 1.2g card suction courier, 0W mirror perch, 4-stage cam, and Optical Flow/ToF): (1) Tier 1 Off-the-Shelf COTS (StampFly + XIAO): 81 x 81 x 24 mm (180 mm span, 41.65 g, 33 mm ducts); (2) Tier 2 Custom Single-PCB HDI Floor (Macaron / AirPods Pro Case Size): 58 x 58 x 19 mm closed -> 125 mm wingspan, 25.0 g dry / 27.7 g ball-loaded, using four 24 mm ducts + 0702 brushless motors on a 31 mm wheelbase + 200 mAh high-rate cell. Carrying the 2.7 g (40 mm) ball at x = +30 mm ahead of CG (to clear the 42-deg Optical Flow cone) requires 8.23 g/motor on the front pair (71.6% of 11.5 g max thrust, leaving 28.4% control authority) and preserves ~3.6 min hover; (3) Hard Physics Wall Below 55 mm (e.g., 42 x 42 mm Coin Drone, 16 g): Front 18 mm ducts saturate at 102.4% thrust and flip nose-over under the 81 g*mm ball torque, or pulling the 40 mm ball rearward blocks >65% of the Optical Flow cone, while disk loading spikes to 1.83 g/cm2 (>72 dBA whine, <78s flight).

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) brainstorm on Porcelain Scarab x Garden synergy (A Bug in Your Garden): (1) Hands-Free Proof Photographer for Solo Cooking & Potluck Seeds (perched on kitchen backsplash/mirror, triggers visible 3-2-1 LED countdown, 15-deg shell crack or 8s overhead table hop, piping straight into Garden 1-Sheet Compound Proof sheet for Keep/Retake + 1-5 Star Dish Review); (2) Physical NFC Seed Leaf Courier at House Parties & Game Nights (carries a 1.2g NFC/QR card or starting token via chin suction/mandibles and peel-drops it at 75-85 deg flare so guests tap to Check-In and unlock live tools like Life Counter, Dish Claimer, and Winner Ballot); (3) Progressive Streak Familiar for Multi-Day Seeds (Day 1 shy 15-deg peek -> Day 5 wing stretch -> Day 10 full 18cm 2Hz Iridescent Bloom Dance on the Nest).

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) root-cause analysis on why the Porcelain Scarab has not been built yet: (1) The Three-Tribe Blindspot: Drone companies (DJI, HoverAir, Snap) optimize for continuous flight endurance and outdoor speed so non-lifting beetle shells and a 5-min battery look like failure; Academic biomimetic labs (EPFL, Konkuk KUBeetle, Harvard) insisted on generating lift from flapping wings (sacrificing payload, camera stability, and acoustics) and viewed a hidden quadrotor under decorative elytra as cheating; Desk-pet makers (EMO, Loona, LOVOT) stayed on wheels to avoid rotor noise, blade hazards, and autonomous docking failures. (2) Systems-Economics Convergence (2024-2026): Off-the-shelf integration of  shrouded optical-flow/ToF quads (StampFly), 3.5g edge-vision SoCs (XIAO ESP32S3), 1.5g linear servos, and 0.4mm consumer vase-mode printing dropped the cost of attempting the synthesis from k lab custom work to ~. (3) The Real Engineering Bottlenecks (Making the 100th Unattended Landing Boring): Passive suction fails on porous drywall (must use mirrors/glass or magnetic wall target discs), 31-35mm ducts are ~62-66 dBA (making 12s hops + 0W perch mandatory), and optical flow drifts in dim light (requiring forgiving mechanical funnel + fiducial terminal guidance).

PG-SCARAB-INDOOR-V1) for the Palm-Sized Indoor Porcelain Scarab (8.1 x 8.1 x 2.4 cm -> 18.0 cm span, 41.65g) at https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/blueprint.html and embedded on https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/. Features synchronized (1) Side-Elevation Cross-Section & Room Action, (2) Top-Down Orthographic Plan (2.2:1), and (3) 4-Stage Slotted-Cam & L1<L2 Differential Y-Tendon Multiplexer (5:1 Zoom) across 6 interactive indoor utility modes (3D Ping-Pong/Ring Fetch, 2D Suction Instax/Card Courier, 0W Wall-Sit & Stare Sentinel, 0.18J Nest Spring Jump-Start, 9.2 m/s Keyboard Air-Duster, and High-Wall 7AM Alarm & Stove Thermal Patrol).

Published Interactive Stage 6 (Outdoor 2S Wind-Tuck at 22 deg + 100k lux Sun + 6.5 GHz UWB 3D Homing Beam + 9.0x9.0x1.6cm MagSafe-sized Scarab Pocket Nest unfolding 16cm Origami Capture Petals + 0.15s Reverse-DShot touchdown kiss) and Section 2B comparison matrix live to https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/.

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) architecture & wind-physics stress test for Indoor/Outdoor 2S Scarab + Portable Battery-Pack Homing Pad (Scarab Pocket Nest, 9.0x9.0x1.6 cm): (1) Wind Physics & Sail Effect: 1S brushed 42g gets blown backward in >6 mph (2.7 m/s) wind, especially with 60-deg flared elytra acting as 42 cm2 bluff sails. Upgrading to 2S 1002/1103 brushless (50-54g AUW, 130-180 gf thrust = 2.6-3.5:1 TWR) + Outdoor Tuck Mode (retracting elytra to 22-25 deg intake-clear feather or sliding outboard) enables stable photo hover in 9-12 mph (4.0-5.4 m/s, Beaufort 3) sustained wind and 15-18 mph (6.7-8.0 m/s, Beaufort 4) return-to-pad survival; (2) Outdoor Sensor Fusion: Replaces sunlight-blind VL53L3CX (>0.8m) and grass-confused PMW3901 optical flow with Pad-Anchored Dual-Ended UWB (Qorvo DW3000 6.5/8 GHz, 50m LOS range, +-6-10cm distance + PDOA 3D vector when pad is set down face-up, or range-leash in pocket) + BMP581 shrouded barometer + camera VIO; (3) Portable Battery-Pack Homing Pad: 9.0x9.0x1.6 cm MagSafe-style pack (5,000 mAh at 145g for 6-7 recharges OR 10,000 mAh at 215g for 13-15 recharges, 2C-3C 15-20 min fast charge via 4-pin balance pogo rails + Halbach shielded magnetic chamfer + flip-out 15 cm wind-capture petals + reverse-DShot kiss touchdown).

Completed 3-model USPTO Art Unit 3640/3646 Examiner Deep-Dive on Claim Cluster 1 (Single-Actuator 4-Stage Slotted-Cam & Lost-Motion Tendon Multiplexer): (1) Discovered prior art US4846429A (slack-strap suction lip peel), US5454540A, US11866168B2 (ladybug split camera shell), EPFL Vourtsis/Floreano Robotic Elytra, and lost-motion UAV wing linkages. (2) Calibrated Allowance Probabilities: Scope A (Broad functional single-actuator shell+release) = 5-15% (rejected under 35 USC 103 KSR aggregation); Scope B (Intermediate 4-stage slotted cam + differential L1<L2 Y-tendon kinematic sequence) = 35-65%; Scope C (Narrow mechanical safety gate interlocking duct-intake clearance prior to wall-suction peel + over-travel aero-drag/CG trim synergy with test data) = 50-85%. (3) Identified Single-Actuator Design-Around Trap (competitor adds zsh.80 0.3g SMA wire/2nd servo) and solved via Actuator-Neutral Geometric/Aerodynamic Packaging + Control Interlock independent claims.

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) patentability and claim-clustering audit for Photogenik ('The Porcelain Scarab'): (1) Top Utility Patent Claim Clusters: Claim Cluster 1 (Single-Actuator Multi-Stage Lost-Motion Multiplexing on a <50g MAV: 0-15 deg perched camera visor peek, 15-65 deg outboard elytra/sub-wing deployment, 65-75 deg suction edge-peel vacuum release, 75-85 deg mandible caliper release via slotted cam/tendon); Claim Cluster 2 (Outboard Intake-Clearing Split Carapace over a Shrouded Multirotor + Ballistic Spring Launch Sequencing prior to rotor spin-up); Claim Cluster 3 (Bimodal Chin Perch-and-Pick Manipulator + Downwash-Mitigating 'Land-Beside, Idle & Nose-Tilt' Control Sequence that preserves ventral Optical Flow/ToF cones); (2) Design Patents (35 USC 171): Ornamental 3-state silhouette (8.1cm closed pebble, 15-deg wall brooch, 18cm winged scarab + charging nest); (3) Public Disclosure & UCLA IP Rules: Publishing https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/ started the 12-month US grace period (35 USC 102(b)(1)); USPTO Provisional fees are 5 (Micro-Entity) / 30 (Small-Entity), and if built at UCLA, keep significant university research funds/facilities separate or check UCLA Tech Development Group (TDG) undergrad maker-space rules so student retains 100% IP.

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) prior-art and novelty audit for Photogenik ('The Porcelain Scarab'): (1) Existing Prior Art by Component: Flapping beetle robots (Konkuk KUBeetle-S 15.8g; EPFL/Konkuk Rhinoceros Beetle Nature Aug 2024 18g with passive origami hindwing deployment), biomimetic showpieces (Festo BionicBee 34g using UWB indoor localization, eMotionButterflies, MetaFly), wall-perching UAVs (Stanford SCAMP spined fixed-wing/quad, Sherbrooke S-MAD fixed-wing, Imperial/MIT/UCSD suction/gecko quads), and enclosed ducted drones (Cleo Robotics Dronut 425g, HoverAir X1, Tiny Whoops); (2) Why the Combination Has Not Existed: Academic biomimetic labs focused on flapping-wing lift (sacrificing camera stability, quietness, and payload margin), while commercial ducted/camera drone builders treated shells as static plastic cages without articulating elytra or 0W wall-perching; (3) Defensible System-Integration Novelty of the Porcelain Scarab: A sub-50g protected-rotor robot that decouples propulsion (8.1cm 4-duct core) from biomimetic expression (split 0.4mm elytra + passive Mylar sub-wings deployed outboard of the duct intake lip), paired with a 0.18J spring-launch nest, passive vertical wall attachment with a 15-deg peeking visor, and single-servo lost-motion multiplexed manipulation.

Completed 3-Model Swarm Triad (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) brainstorm and build of the 26-second Fortiche/Arcane-style 3D + 2D hand-painted Product Demo Animation for Photogenik ('The Porcelain Scarab'), inspired by ChrisGPT's Fable 5.5 / Fortiche workbench animation: (1) Procedural gouache & Voronoi porcelain-crackle + brushed antique brass bump-mapped textures in a moonlit arched studio workbench with flickering amber oil lantern and brass clockwork gear; (2) Quantized 12 fps ('Animated on 2s') character poses + 2D hand-drawn grease-pencil FX (cyan awakening sparks, 0.18J spring launch burst + dual chalk shockwave rings, 220Hz laminar louver slipstream ribbons, 42-deg Optical Flow / 27-deg ToF belly cone with stepped scan-rings, and 85-deg wing-flare tendon snap); (3) 5-Act 26.0s choreography with 44.1kHz procedural WAV audio synthesis (clockwork chirp, spring ka-chunk/boing, 220Hz muffled rotor hum, suction thwock-pop, portrait shutter double-click, ping-pong scoop & brass cup clink); (4) Rendered to 1280x720 MP4 (scarab_product_demo_26s.mp4, 8.4MB) and published live at https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/ and https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/cinema.html.

Completed 3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) battery chemistry & multi-day endurance roadmap for Photogenik Scarab: (1) Micro-Pouch Packaging & C-Rate Reality Check: Headline 450-500 Wh/kg cells drop to 150-260 Wh/kg at 8-12g size due to ~22-28% pouch/foil/tab overhead, and standard smartphone Si-C cells (designed for 0.5-1.5C) sag under 12-17C brushed hover loads unless paired with Brushless 1103 motors (cutting hover draw from 22W to 11W, or ~4-6C); (2) Best Entry Consumer Cell Today (2026): Grepow / BetaFPV Lava II Z-Folded 4.35V LiHV 320-480mAh (8.2g-12.6g, 155-168 Wh/kg, -) for high-rate off-the-shelf, OR Amprius SiCore SA90 / Grepow Semi-Solid Si-C 10-12g OEM pouch (~210-240 Wh/kg sustained at 5-8C, ~2.3-2.6 Wh); (3) 1-2 Year Horizon (2027-2028): 2nd/3rd-Gen High-Silicon (25-50% Si-C / Enovix 3D-constrained EX-2M/EX-3M / Amprius SiCore high-rate micro-pouch) delivering 250-290 Wh/kg at 11-12g (~2.8-3.3 Wh), unlocking ~13-15 min continuous brushless hover; (4) Multi-Day 'Magic Layer': Combining Brushless (11W hover) + 12g Si-C (2.8-3.2 Wh) + 5mW PIR/ToF Deep-Sleep Perch (waking 350mW camera only on motion) + 0.6g flexible GaAs/perovskite solar film on the outer Elytra (harvesting ~0.4-1.0 Wh/day perched on a window vs ~0.5 Wh/day perched draw) makes window-perching energy-neutral and stretches time between nest charges to 4-7+ days.

Updated live public Photogenik Scarab web proposal (https://portalstest.github.io/photogenik-scarab/) with 3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) Dual-Mode Micro-Manipulation & Double-Duty Utility system: (1) Added Interactive Stage 5 (Scoop, Suction & Drop) with toggle between 3D Mode (2.7g 40mm ping-pong ball scooped via 0.95g 25-30 deg forward carbon-wire Stag Mandibles) and 2D Mode (1.2g Instax photo / 1.8g playing card picked up via 0.8g bimodal chin suction pad using Opus 5.5 Land-Beside, Idle & Nose-Tilt maneuver to prevent outwash blow-away); (2) Shared 0.08mm Dyneema Lost-Motion Tendon on the 1.7g wing servo executes staged mid-air release (65-75 deg pulls 1.5mm suction edge-peel tab to break 3.8N vacuum seal in <30ms; 75-85 deg spreads carbon mandibles to 45mm to drop a ping-pong ball into a cup); (3) Added Top-Down CAD Blueprint visualization of forward mandibles, bimodal suction pad, and unobstructed belly PMW3901/VL53L3CX cones.

Completed 3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1 MAX + Argon 4 High) engineering design for <1.5g Ultra-Thin Operational Arms (Beetle Tarsi / Stag Mandibles) on the 8.1cm Photogenik Scarab: (1) Mass Budget: 2.7g (40mm) ping-pong ball + 1.0g carbon-wire mandibles = 3.7g total added load, fitting inside StampFly ~6-8g lift margin (or Crazyflie Brushless 15-25g margin); (2) Solves 2 physics traps: Belly Sensor Blindness (PMW3901 Optical Flow 42-deg + VL53L3CX ToF 27-deg) and Rotor Downwash/Outwash Roll-Away by mounting 0.5mm carbon-fiber/spring-steel mandibles at a 25-30 deg forward-downward chin angle; (3) Passive Bistable Snap-In (38mm pre-loaded arc snaps past 40mm ball equator with 0W holding power) + Lost-Motion Wing-Servo Tendon Release (or 0.05g Nitinol latch pin) to drop the ball mid-air; (4) Land-Behind-and-Scoop pickup maneuver avoids blowing the 2.7g ball away.

3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 21.7s + Argon 4 High 45.3s + Sol 6.1 MAX 67.4s) synthesized non-photo utilities and <0.5g add-on sensors for Photogenik ('The Porcelain Scarab'): (1) High-Wall Un-Snoozable Morning Sunrise Alarm & Sleep/CO2 Sentinel (flies to a high bedroom wall/mirror out of arm's reach so you must stand up to dismiss it), (2) Stair-Proof 'Did I Leave the Stove/Iron/Tap On?' Inspector (hops over floor clutter/stairs + uses 0.05g MLX90632 IR thermal sensor or mic FFT), (3) 3D Ceiling/Room Air-Quality & VOC/Smoke Sniffer (Bosch BME688 0.09g ~ sensor samples ceiling-stratified smoke/VOC/CO2 across rooms), (4) Roaming Line-of-Sight IR Blaster (<0.1g ~bash.50 IR LED controls legacy AC units/TVs/fans in any room), (5) Physical 'Point-and-Find' Laser/Lantern Guide & Cat Exerciser (flies to the shelf/keys/AirTag and points or plays with pets from a safe high wall perch), and (6) Clutter-Free Kitchen Backsplash / Bathroom Mirror / Desk Pomodoro Co-Pilot.

3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 19.5s + Argon 4 High 34.0s + Sol 6.1 MAX 34.3s) synthesized the 2026 market landscape and strategic opportunity for Photogenik ('The Porcelain Scarab'): (1) Split Market Today: Pocket flying cameras (HOVERAir X1/Smart/PRO 99-99 at 99-192g, DJI Neo 99 at 135g, failed AirSelfie 52g & recalled Snap Pixy 101g) are loud (70-80 dBA), dockless outdoor/action camera utilities that die in 10-16 min, while AI companion pets (LivingAI EMO 69 / AIBI 49, KEYi Loona 29, LOVOT ,800+) have charging docks and personality but are trapped on desks/floors; (2) Unowned White Space ('Living Ambient Photographer' / Perch-First Flying Pet): Zero products combine a self-charging home nest, 0W wall/mirror perching for eye-level room vantage points, and brief 15-second repositioning flights; (3) First Proof Required: Demonstrate 100+ reliable cycles of the complete transition loop (Nest Spring Launch -> 15s Flight -> Passive Wall-Perch & Eye-Level Portrait -> Return to Nest) and validate that people prefer its candid eye-level photos/presence after novelty fades.

3-Model Team (Opus 5.5 36.8s + Argon 4 High 42.2s + Sol 6.1 MAX 56.0s) verified continuous hover endurance & wall-sitting duty-cycle math (P ~ m^1.5): (1) ~8 UCLA StampFly Scarab (35.8g base + 4.9g shell = 40.7g on 1S 300mAh LiHV ~1.14Wh): ~2.7-3.4 min continuous hover (~2.2-2.7 min at 44.2g with onboard XIAO camera); (2) Crazyflie 2.1 Brushless Scarab (42-45g): ~6.8-8.2 min continuous hover (~12.5-15 min with future 325 Wh/kg silicon-anode cell); (3) Wall-Sitting Duty Cycle: converts 2.7-3.4 min of continuous flight (~16W hover draw) into 8-12 separate 15-second room-crossing hops PLUS 45-60 min of continuous Wi-Fi video streaming or 6-8+ hours of low-power (~20-80mW PIR/ToF wake) perched room presence per charge.
